name: novel-to-game
description: A text-cited 5-skill novel-to-game workflow covering adaptation-focused novel analysis, staged concept/world/art design, environment-aware runtime builds, and first-player blind-playtest QA. It supports systems games, interactive fiction and interactive film. 忠于原著的 5-skill 小说改游戏工作流，涵盖游戏化拆书、概念/世界/美术分阶段策划、结合当前运行环境构建游戏及新玩家实机盲玩验收，支持系统玩法、互动叙事与互动影游。

interface.shortDescription: Turn novels into playable game prototypes · 把小说改编成可玩的游戏
